name.name: Lymphocyte antigen 6 complex locus protein G6c

description.text: The function of LY6G6C is not clear [[cite:PUB00089336]]. It is a GPI-anchored cell surface protein, highly expressed at the leading edges of cells, on filopodia, which are normally involved in cell adhesion and migration [[cite:PUB00088386]]. Homologues are found only in mammals.

PUB00088386.title: Characterization of the five novel Ly-6 superfamily members encoded in the MHC, and detection of cells expressing their potential ligands.

PUB00089336.title: Genes encoding three new members of the leukocyte antigen 6 superfamily and a novel member of Ig superfamily, together with genes encoding the regulatory nuclear chloride ion channel protein (hRNCC) and an N omega-N omega-dimethylarginine dimethylaminohydrolase homologue, are found in a 30-kb segment of the MHC class III region.
